paite: Israelte atamdan uh inkuan makaipente, sepaih sangkhat heutute, zakhat heutute leh kumpipa nasem mite tengteng kum khat sung a kha teng a kikheng zelzel, pawl chih a mi singnih-le-sangli ahi uhi.
heading: Sepaihhon Apawlpawl A Kikhendan

paite: Pawl khatna akha khatna a heutu Zabdiel tapa Jashobeam ahi a, pawl ah singnih-le-sangli a-om uh.
Amah Perez suan a mi, akha khatna a sepaih heutu tengteng makaipen ahi.
Akha nihna pawl a heutu Ahoh mi Dodai ahi a, apawl a mi Mikloth leng ahi a, apawl uah singnih-le-sangli a-om uhi.
Akha thumna a sepaihte heutupen siampu Jehoiada tapa Benaiah ahi a, apawl ah singnih-le-sangli a-om uh.
Hiai Benaiah ahi a, sawmthum lak a mihangsan, sawmthum tung a mi pen; apawl ah atapa Ammizabad atel hi.
Akha lina a sepaih heutu Joab unaupa Asahel ahi a, atapa Zebadiah asik a pang ahi, apawl ah singnih-le-sangli a-om uh.
Akha ngana a sepaih heutu Izrah mi Shamhuth ahi a, apawl ah singnih-le-sangli a-om uh.
Akha gukna a sepaih heutu Tekoa mi, Ikkesh tapa Ira ahi a, apawl ah singnih-le-sangli a-om uh.
Akha sagihna a sepaih heutu Ephraim suan Pelon mi Helez ahi a, apawl ah singnih-le-sangli a-om uh.
Akha giatna a sepaih heutu Zerah suan Husat mi Sibbekai ahi a, apawl ah singnih-le-sangli a-om uh.
Akha kuana a sepaih heutu Benjamin suan Anathoth mi Abiezer ahi a, apawl ah singnih-le-sangli a-om uh.
Akha sawmna a sepaih heutu Zerah suan Netophah mi Maharai ahi a, apawl ah singnih sangli a-om uh.
Akha sawm-le-khatna a sepaih heutu Ephraim suan Pirathon mi Benaiah ahi a, apawl ah singnih-le-sangli a-om uh.
Akha sawm-le-nihna a sepaih heutu Othniel suan Netophah mi Heldai ahi a, apawl ah singnih-le-sangli a-om uh.
Huai lou leng, Israel namte tung a: Reubente lak a Zikri tapa Eliezer vaihawmpa ahi a, Simeonte lak ah Maakah tapa Shephatiah ahi;
heading: Israel Namte Vaihawmtute

paite: Levite lak ah Kumuel tapa, Hashabiah; Aaronte lak ah Zadok;
Judate lak ah David unaute lak ah Elihu, Issakarte lak ah Mikael tapa Omri;
Zebulunte lak ah Obadiah tapa Ishmaiah; Naphtalite lak ah Azriel tapa Jeremoth;
Ephraim suante lak ah Azaziah tapa Hoshea; Manasseh nam kimkhatte lak ah Pedaiah tapa Joel.
Gilead gam a Manasseh nam kimkhatte lak ah, Zekariah tapa Ido; Benjaminte lak ah, Abner tapa Jaasiel;
Dante lak ah Jeroham tapa Azariel. Huaite Israel nam heutute ahi uh.
David in kum sawmnih a kipan anuailam asim kei hi, Israelte bel van a aksi zah in apungsak ding chih TOUPA'N ana gen khit tak ziak in.
Zeruiah tapa Joab in asim pan a, himahleh asimzou kei a, Israelte tung ah leng hehna ahong tungta a; kumpipa David vaihawm lai khangthubute ah azah gelh leng ahi sam kei hi.
Kumpipa sumkempa Adiel tapa Azmaveth ahi a; huan lou lam ah, khopite ah, khopel khawng ah, insangte a sumkempa bel Uzziah tapa Jehonathan ahi.
heading: Kumpipa Van Kem A Enkoltute

paite: Lou a leileh nasep sem kempa Kelub tapa Ezri ahi a;
Grephuan kempa Ramath mi, Shimei ahi a, grephuan a uain suksa koihkhawm kempa Shiph mite mi Zabdi ahi.
Phaiguam olive sing leh theipi kungte kempa Geder mi Baal-hanan ahi a, sathau koihkhawmna kempa Joash ahi.
Sharon a ta ganhon kempa Sharon mi Shitrai ahi a, Phaizang a ganhon kempa Adlai tapa Shaphat ahi.
Sangawngsau kempa Ishmael mi Obil ahi a, sabiltung kempa Meronoth mi Jehdeiah ahi a;
belamhon kempa Hagar mi Jaziz ahi. Huaite tengteng kumpipa David sumkem mite ahi uh.
Huan David paneu, Jonathan tuh mipil, laisiam mahmah thu theipen ahi a, huan amah leh Hakmoni tapa Jehiel in kumpipa tapate asinsak uhi.
heading: David Thukuppente

paite: Kumpipa lemgelpihpa Ahithophel ahi a; Arki mi Hushai kumpipa lawm ahi a.
Ahithophel zom in Benaiah tapa Jehoiada leh Abiathar ahi ua, kumpipa sepaih heutu bel Joab ahi.
